scientific_integrity: The counterexample mechanism is analytic: an exact boundary limit is negative and continuity transfers the sign to nearby interior points. Numerical evaluations are supplemental and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The criterion \((a-b)(a+b)^2>ac^2\) is sufficient rather than necessary, and the proof does not optimize the radius of the violating neighborhood. Unindexed prior literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: A vertex-boundary obstruction to Liu's Conjecture 3.8
